title: BlackLanturn 1.1.29
summary: Current update information and direct Update selection.

sections.heading: Clearer update availability
bullets: Updates shows the newest release already known to BlackLanturn, even when an older manual check is saved.
A known available update is ready without a separate Check now. The last manual-check time and result remain visible.

sections.heading: Easier navigation
bullets: Update BlackLanturn is selected when you enter Updates and a newer release is available.
Returning from another page keeps your place. Opening Updates adds no network requests.

sections.heading: Keep your complete setup
bullets: Update BlackLanturn updates bundled add-ons, Installer and tested patches together.
Settings, accounts, playback preferences, sources, watched progress and other add-ons stay in place. Close and reopen Kodi after updating.
